passages.text: Come near, O nations, to listen; pay attention, O peoples. Let the earth hear, and all that fills it, the world and all that springs from it.
passages.sermon:
God calls all nations to listen.
God commands every people to pay attention.
God wants the whole earth to hear.
Everything on the earth must listen.
The world and all its offspring must hear God’s message.
passages.original: קִרְב֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים הַקְשִׁ֑יבוּ תִּשְׁמַ֤ע הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ תֵּבֵ֖ל וְכָל־ צֶאֱצָאֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: The LORD is angry with all the nations and furious with all their armies. He will devote them to destruction; He will give them over to slaughter.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is angry with all the nations.
The LORD is furious with all their armies.
The LORD will devote the nations and their armies to destruction.
The LORD will give them over to slaughter.
passages.original: כִּ֣י קֶ֤צֶף לַֽיהוָה֙ עַל־ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֵמָ֖ה עַל־ כָּל־ צְבָאָ֑ם הֶחֱרִימָ֖ם נְתָנָ֥ם לַטָּֽבַח׃

passages.text: Their slain will be left unburied, and the stench of their corpses will rise; the mountains will flow with their blood.
passages.sermon:
God is angry with all the nations.
God is furious with all their armies.
God will destroy them.
God will give them over to slaughter.
Their dead bodies will lie unburied.
The smell of their corpses will rise.
Blood will flow from their bodies.
The mountains will melt from their blood.
passages.original: וְחַלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יֻשְׁלָ֔כוּ וּפִגְרֵיהֶ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה בָאְשָׁ֑ם וְנָמַ֥סּוּ הָרִ֖ים מִדָּמָֽם׃

passages.text: All the stars of heaven will be dissolved. The skies will be rolled up like a scroll, and all their stars will fall like withered leaves from the vine, like foliage from the fig tree.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is angry with all the nations.
God is furious with all their armies.
God will judge them.
God will show His power in the heavens.
All the stars in the sky will waste away.
The sky will roll up like a scroll.
Every star will fall down.
The stars will fall like leaves from a vine.
The stars will fall like figs from a fig tree.
passages.original: וְנָמַ֙קּוּ֙ כָּל־ צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְנָגֹ֥לּוּ כַסֵּ֖פֶר הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְכָל־ צְבָאָ֣ם יִבּ֔וֹל כִּנְבֹ֤ל עָלֶה֙ מִגֶּ֔פֶן וּכְנֹבֶ֖לֶת מִתְּאֵנָֽה׃

passages.text: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says His sword has become full in the heavens.
God will bring His sword down on Edom.
God will judge the people He has set apart for destruction.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ רִוְּתָ֥ה בַשָּׁמַ֖יִם חַרְבִּ֑י הִנֵּה֙ עַל־ אֱד֣וֹם תֵּרֵ֔ד וְעַל־ עַ֥ם חֶרְמִ֖י לְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: The sword of the LORD is bathed in blood. It drips with fat— with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams. For the LORD has a sacrifice in Bozrah, a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD holds a sword.
The sword of the LORD is covered in blood.
The sword is soaked with fat.
The blood comes from lambs and goats.
The fat comes from the kidneys of rams.
The LORD has prepared a sacrifice in Bozrah.
Bozrah is a city in Edom.
The LORD will carry out a great slaughter in the land of Edom.
passages.original: חֶ֣רֶב לַיהוָ֞ה מָלְאָ֥ה דָם֙ הֻדַּ֣שְׁנָה מֵחֵ֔לֶב מִדַּ֤ם כָּרִים֙ וְעַתּוּדִ֔ים מֵחֵ֖לֶב כִּלְי֣וֹת אֵילִ֑ים כִּ֣י זֶ֤בַח לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּבָצְרָ֔ה וְטֶ֥בַח גָּד֖וֹל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃

passages.text: And the wild oxen will fall with them, the young bulls with the strong ones. Their land will be drenched with blood, and their soil will be soaked with fat.
passages.sermon:
God judges Edom.
Wild oxen will fall with the people of Edom.
Young bulls will fall with the strong ones.
Their land will be drenched with blood.
Their soil will be soaked with fat.
passages.original: וְיָרְד֤וּ רְאֵמִים֙ עִמָּ֔ם וּפָרִ֖ים עִם־ אַבִּירִ֑ים וְרִוְּתָ֤ה אַרְצָם֙ מִדָּ֔ם וַעֲפָרָ֖ם מֵחֵ֥לֶב יְדֻשָּֽׁן׃

passages.text: For the LORD has a day of vengeance, a year of recompense for the cause of Zion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD has set a day for vengeance.
The LORD will repay those who oppose Zion.
This is the year when the LORD will bring justice for Zion’s cause.
passages.original: כִּ֛י י֥וֹם נָקָ֖ם לַֽיהוָ֑ה שְׁנַ֥ת שִׁלּוּמִ֖ים לְרִ֥יב צִיּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Edom’s streams will be turned to tar, and her soil to sulfur; her land will become a blazing pitch.
passages.sermon:
Edom is a nation.
God will judge Edom.
Edom’s streams will become tar.
Edom’s soil will become sulfur.
Edom’s land will burn like blazing pitch.
passages.original: וְנֶהֶפְכ֤וּ נְחָלֶ֙יהָ֙ לְזֶ֔פֶת וַעֲפָרָ֖הּ לְגָפְרִ֑ית וְהָיְתָ֣ה אַרְצָ֔הּ לְזֶ֖פֶת בֹּעֵרָֽה׃

passages.text: It will not be quenched—day or night. Its smoke will ascend forever. From generation to generation it will lie desolate; no one will ever again pass through it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will judge Edom for the cause of Zion.
Edom’s land will burn with fire.
The fire will not go out at night.
The fire will not go out during the day.
Smoke will rise from the land forever.
The land will stay empty for all generations.
No one will ever pass through it again.
passages.original: לַ֤יְלָה וְיוֹמָם֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה לְעוֹלָ֖ם יַעֲלֶ֣ה עֲשָׁנָ֑הּ מִדּ֤וֹר לָדוֹר֙ תֶּחֱרָ֔ב לְנֵ֣צַח נְצָחִ֔ים אֵ֥ין עֹבֵ֖ר בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: The desert owl and screech owl will possess it, and the great owl and raven will dwell in it. The LORD will stretch out over Edom a measuring line of chaos and a plumb line of destruction.
passages.sermon:
Edom is a land.
Edom will become desolate.
The desert owl will take possession of Edom.
The screech owl will also possess Edom.
The great owl will live in Edom.
The raven will also live in Edom.
The LORD will act over Edom.
The LORD will use a measuring line of chaos.
The LORD will use a plumb line of destruction.
passages.original: וִירֵשׁ֙וּהָ֙ קָאַ֣ת וְקִפּ֔וֹד וְיַנְשׁ֥וֹף וְעֹרֵ֖ב יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָ֑הּ וְנָטָ֥ה עָלֶ֛יהָ קַֽו־ תֹ֖הוּ וְאַבְנֵי־ בֹֽהוּ׃

passages.text: No nobles will be left to proclaim a king, and all her princes will come to nothing.
passages.sermon: Edom will have no nobles left.\r\nNo one will be there to proclaim a king.\r\nAll her princes will become nothing.
passages.original: חֹרֶ֥יהָ וְאֵֽין־ שָׁ֖ם מְלוּכָ֣ה יִקְרָ֑אוּ וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֖יהָ יִ֥הְיוּ אָֽפֶס׃

passages.text: Her towers will be overgrown with thorns, her fortresses with thistles and briers. She will become a haunt for jackals, an abode for ostriches.
passages.sermon:
Edom is the subject of this prophecy.
Edom’s towers will stand empty.
Thorns will cover her towers.
Thistles and briers will grow in her fortresses.
Jackals will live there.
Ostriches will make their home there.
passages.original: וְעָלְתָ֤ה אַרְמְנֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ סִירִ֔ים קִמּ֥וֹשׂ וָח֖וֹחַ בְּמִבְצָרֶ֑יהָ וְהָיְתָה֙ נְוֵ֣ה תַנִּ֔ים חָצִ֖יר לִבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃

passages.text: The desert creatures will meet with hyenas, and one wild goat will call to another. There the night creature will settle and find her place of repose.
passages.sermon:
Desert creatures will meet hyenas.
Wild goats will call to each other.
The night creature will settle there.
She will find a place to rest.
passages.original: וּפָגְשׁ֤וּ צִיִּים֙ אֶת־ אִיִּ֔ים וְשָׂעִ֖יר עַל־ רֵעֵ֣הוּ יִקְרָ֑א אַךְ־ שָׁם֙ הִרְגִּ֣יעָה לִּילִ֔ית וּמָצְאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ מָנֽוֹחַ׃

passages.text: There the owl will make her nest; she will lay and hatch her eggs and gather her brood under her shadow. Even there the birds of prey will gather, each with its mate.
passages.sermon:
An owl will come to this place.
The owl will build her nest here.
She will lay her eggs in this place.
She will hatch her eggs here.
She will gather her young under her shadow.
Birds of prey will also come to this place.
Each bird of prey will find its mate here.
passages.original: שָׁ֣מָּה קִנְּנָ֤ה קִפּוֹז֙ וַתְּמַלֵּ֔ט וּבָקְעָ֖ה וְדָגְרָ֣ה בְצִלָּ֑הּ אַךְ־ שָׁ֛ם נִקְבְּצ֥וּ דַיּ֖וֹת אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Search and read the scroll of the LORD: Not one of these will go missing, not one will lack her mate, because He has ordered it by His mouth, and He will gather them by His Spirit.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He has a scroll.
You must search the scroll of the LORD.
You must read it.
None of these creatures will be missing.
Each one will have its mate.
God commanded this by His mouth.
God will gather them by His Spirit.
passages.original: דִּרְשׁ֨וּ מֵֽעַל־ סֵ֤פֶר יְהוָה֙ וּֽקְרָ֔אוּ אַחַ֤ת מֵהֵ֙נָּה֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔רָה אִשָּׁ֥ה רְעוּתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א פָקָ֑דוּ כִּֽי־ פִי֙ ה֣וּא צִוָּ֔ה וְרוּח֖וֹ ה֥וּא קִבְּצָֽן׃

passages.text: He has allotted their portion; His hand has distributed it by measure. They will possess it forever; they will dwell in it from generation to generation.
passages.sermon:
God acts with authority.
God gives each creature its share.
God measures out their portion by His hand.
They will own their land forever.
They will live there through every generation.
passages.original: וְהֽוּא־ הִפִּ֤יל לָהֶן֙ גּוֹרָ֔ל וְיָד֛וֹ חִלְּקַ֥תָּה לָהֶ֖ם בַּקָּ֑ו עַד־ עוֹלָם֙ יִֽירָשׁ֔וּהָ לְד֥וֹר וָד֖וֹר יִשְׁכְּנוּ־ בָֽהּ׃ס
